name: Dynamic World V1: Near Real-Time Global 10m Land Use Land Cover Mapping
description: Dynamic World V1 is a near real-time (NRT) global 10-meter resolution Land Use and Land Cover (LULC) dataset produced through a partnership between Google, the World Resources Institute (WRI), and the National Geographic Society. Continuously generated in parallel with every Sentinel-2 L1C acquisition globally from June 2015 to the present, it outputs per-pixel probability distributions and categorical argmax classifications across 9 land cover classes: water, trees, grass, flooded_vegetation, crops, shrub_and_scrub, built, bare, and snow_and_ice. The underlying deep learning model was trained and validated on a globally distributed dataset of over 24,000 expert-annotated Sentinel-2 tiles.
